scope: Review five newly supplied Android recognition screenshots and compare their visible UI with the currently served scanner bundle.

phone_flow.device: Android phone based on visible status/navigation UI

recognition_summary.pending_reason_visible: 缺少相同食品與食用狀態的可信營養資料，尚未計入營養合計。

comparison_with_batch_65.interpretation: The 5g estimated-weight difference accompanies the visible 10 kcal and 20mg sodium difference. Portion/model estimates varied; this is not an accuracy measurement.

ui_findings.finding: Screenshot 1 shows the old 'Gemini + TFDA' badge and '已辨識 2 項食物' heading, despite five additional pending detections and the USDA-labeled chicken card.
ui_findings.interpretation: At review time the public bundle matched the previously verified corrected build, while these screenshots show older wording. The screenshot capture may predate that deployment or have used a stale browser asset; the available evidence cannot distinguish these causes or identify the exact asset used by the phone.

interpretation_limits: The selected mode is gallery, so these images do not satisfy the pending Android camera shutter gate.
Confidence values are model output fields, not calibrated proof of food identity or nutrition accuracy.
TFDA and USDA reference labels do not prove live provider API calls.
Nutrition values are database references scaled by vision-estimated weights, not measured ground truth.
The visible add-record button does not prove whether it was pressed or whether a write succeeded.
Screenshots do not reveal runtime model provider, app request/retry counts, token usage, cost, Tavily/USDA live calls, or database writes.
next_bounded_action: Use the currently served scanner in Android camera mode, capture the same meal with the shutter, stop on the recognition result, and do not confirm pending candidates, accept a profile, or save a meal record. Reload the current page before the test; verify the corrected summary/source wording, and keep the screen capture distinct from gallery evidence.
